cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Truth or Loyalty
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between protecting the relationship and answering a dangerous question honestly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mum wants to know who broke the vase. I'll handle her; you just keep the promise you made your little brother.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's blaming the cleaner. I can't let that happen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll clear the cleaner together. Does that mean you have to name me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's asked me directly whether you did it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll go in with you if we're keeping the promise. Are you answering her or backing me?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims management of Mum and relies on the sibling promise; A3 concedes clearing the cleaner together; A5 makes A support conditional on B loyalty when the direct question defeats ambiguity.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 name me identifies A as the protected brother; B4 direct question explains why clearing only the cleaner will not suffice.

relationship.evidence: B2 will not let an innocent worker be blamed and B4 reports the exact question requiring a truthful answer.

heightening.evidence: B4 removes the middle course, causing A5 to force backing A versus answering Mum.

specificity.evidence: A1 mother, broken vase and little-brother promise establish the relationship and dangerous disclosure.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 conditional joint presence and the explicit choice each bears on what B will do next.
